reason: Mathematical falsification of v1 H3 prior to any FIT/HELD outcome use. The requirement to beat all negative controls by at least .05 expected regret contradicts the frozen SCM's maximum possible improvement over passive and no_memory. This is a protocol-invalid threshold, not an observed learner NO_GO. Original H3 and frozen negative remain permanently preserved.

derivation.world: FORK for second-B t192..255; c=t%8 uniform eight contexts exactly eight repeats per context; theta in {0,1}
derivation.q_action1: 0.15+0.20*((c0 XOR theta)+(c1 XOR c2 XOR theta))
derivation.impossibility: To beat passive by >=0.05 would require candidate regret <=-0.0125. To beat no_memory in theta1 by >=0.05 would require <=-0.025. Regret is max_a expected_utility - chosen_a expected_utility >= 0 pointwise, so no candidate can satisfy v1 H3.
derivation.realized_vs_expected: These are algebraic expected regrets from public frozen SCM, not realized stochastic y, tuned outcomes or held source calls.

prospective_change.only_superseded_rule: v1 H3, inherited unchanged by v2
prospective_change.new_H3: Candidate second-B mean expected regret at least 0.01 lower than each of passive, deterministic random and fixed no_memory controls in EACH of the two 12-world held theta families.
prospective_change.feasibility: Because theta1 no_memory regret=0.025, an ideal candidate (regret=0) could exceed this >=0.01 target; candidate must reach regret <=0.015 in theta1. All other P0-P1,H1,H2,H4, family sizes, seeds, phases, cold/custody rules, and source budgets remain unchanged.
prospective_change.classification: PREPRIMARY_INVALID_V2 for original H3. Report v3 only if prospectively qualified and no first-use has occurred; never claim v1 H3 passed.
